name: library-surface-non-graph-artifacts
body: BUILD-ARTIFACT GRAPH STATUS + the lib/bin FQN risk — recorded for the plan-writer [autonomous]. (Original premise, now historical: this note was authored when `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh` and `rust-toolchain.toml` had no `File` node, so their edits had to be carried as non-graph tasks; the note's name reflects that superseded premise and is retained as identity.) **Correction (present state):** the shipped structural scanner graphs all four as `File` nodes (`code_type = 'config'`), so each can be an `implemented-by` target or a task target; schedule their edits by FQN. Separately, adding `src/lib.rs` alongside `src/main.rs` makes two source files want the module identity `rust.apg` — the crate-root module currently belongs to `src/main.rs` — so the plan must decide how the library target is rooted (and whether the binary re-exports or renames) without colliding the FQN. This is a plan-writer decision; the spec only records it.
